༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ //

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer mdor bsdus bzhugs so///

na mo lo ke shwa ra ye/ 'phags pa phyag na pad+mo'i bsnyen sgrub la// 'jug 'dod gang yin tho rangs sogs snga bar// bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dang ldan pas| |'don sgom sbrags pa'i nyams len 'di ltar bya// sangs rgyas chos tshogs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// byang chub snying po ma thob de srid bar// bdag sogs 'gro kun gtan gyis skyabs su mchi// sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral nas// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i go 'phang la 'god phyir// bdag gis deng nas byang chub mchog thob bar// 'phags pa bsgom bzlas ting 'dzin don la brtson| |oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shad+dho3haṃ/ gzung 'dzin chos kun gnyis stong 'od gsal ngang*// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i rwa gur me| *|gzhom gzhig bral ba'i dbus su paṃ yig las// pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma 'bum ldan pa'i// ge sar dbus su a las bsil zer can/ *// 'od 'phros steng du rang rig hrīḥdakar po// de las 'od 'phros rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus// 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs 'phags pa'i sa la bkod// 'dus gyur rang nyid phyag na pad+mo'i sku// shel dkar lhun por nyi 'od phog pa bzhin// dkar 'tsher 'od 'phros mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs// spyan dkyus ring zhing shangs dang zhal 'dzum bzhad// mthon mthing dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings// phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ni thugs ka'i thad// mnyam pa'i thal sbyar 'og mas g.yas shel phreng*// g.yon pas pad dkar 'dab brgyad yu ba 'dzin// zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// rin thang med pa'i rin chen sna tshogs kyi// dbu dang snyan mgul phyag zhabs ska rags dang*// do shal se mo do sogs rgyan mang mdzes// sna tshogs dar gyis stod smad sku la klubs// de yi dpral mgrin snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐// dkar dmar sngo ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gnyis med bstims// slar yang 'od des dbang lha rigs lnga bkug

/mchod cing gsol btab bum chus dbang bskur bas// rang gi sgrib sbyangs chu lhag yar 'khyil bas// dpag med gtsor gyur rigs lngas rgyas gdab gyur// ces ci gnas bsgom/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla steng hrīḥdakar mthar// yi ge drug pa mu tig phreng lta bus// g.yas su bskor zhing 'od kyis stong gsum khyab// snang ba lha sku sgra grags yig drug gdangs// dran rtog thugs te rdo rje gsum gyi ngang*// tha mal zhen rtog 'od gsal ye shes mes// sbyangs te zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ci nus bzla/ thun mthar/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis brtan g.yo'i tshogs/ */skad cig bsdus nas rang lus lha skur thim/ */lha sku stod smad 'od kyis thugs ka'i hrīḥr/ */bsdus shing de yang mi dmigs 'od gsal ngang*/ */zung 'jug bde ba chen por 'ub kyis chub// ces don bsgom/ slar yang*/ de yi ngang las rang mdangs rig pa'i rtsal// snang ba lha sku stong pa chos nyid dbyings// zung 'jug spyan ras gzigs su gdod nas grub// kun brtags rtog pa'i bskyed rim mtshan ma spangs// gang shar lha sku'i rnam rol e ma hoḥ zhes spyod lam rnam bzhi spyad/ smon lam ni/ kye kye bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar| |mi dge'i las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams// don ma rtogs pas 'khrul ngor zad// rang ngo shes na rang sar grol// rang rig bde chen chos kyi sku// mtha' bral rang byung rtogs par shog /gzhan yang tshe rabs kun tu bdag /dal 'byor mchog thob bstan dang mjal// dam pas rjes bzung sdom pa gsum// legs mnos srog bzhin bsrung ba dang*// de 'bras mchog gi sa thob shog /gnas skabs mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs// nad gdon bar gcod kun zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par shog

|dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun// 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces don dran bzhin pas kha ton bya'o// zhes pa'ang dge slong bsam 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
